counts.interpretation: Zero actuals mean this source plan records no executed customer outcomes; it is not a census of other project activity.

purchase_counting.unit: An original, customer-approved useful purchase bound to its actual native payment outcome and complete received task.
do_not_count: HTTP or provider retries of one original request
A2A reconnect/resubscribe or resumed native work
Several output formats for one query/report
Challenge-only, declined, failed or unresolved settlement attempts
Development fixtures and the existing team testnet baseline
An automatically repeated purchase with no separate useful customer task
purchase_counting.unknown_rule: Retain the original request and reconcile its native outcome. An uncertain send or settlement is not permission to create another purchase.

funded_adaptation.remaining_work: Bind the two actual merchant resources, customer source populations, approved saved queries/reports and complete output contracts; record the existing reusable components selected.
Name the actual buyer/merchant/receiving operators and configure their original approval, source-license, signer and operating responsibilities.
Deploy the selected customer provider/ledger configuration and execute the separate real testnet commissioning schedule.
Exercise the original deployment-specific denial, disconnect and uncertain-payment recovery cases with their native request identities.
Commission the customer-approved mainnet calendar and complete the original useful jobs across both independent buyers and merchant installations.
Have the receiving engineer restore the actual complete package, reopen results, reconcile original outcomes and accept operating ownership.

attribution_rule: No hours or price are added by this appendix. Attribute each actual adaptation once to its funded package or its separately commissioned workorder. Completed reusable source is the starting component and is not billed again as future creation.
